runners.comment: 1-18 on the AW; bounced back to form when runner-up at Newcastle over 6f ten days ago

runners.comment: 1-20; shaped more encouragingly in first-time cheekpieces at Wolverhampton 39 days ago

runners.comment: Up 2lb for his C&D success 15 days ago; higher grade this time but should go well again
runners.name: Fools Rush In

runners.comment: Won over C&D last month but never featured behind Fools Rush In on his latest start

runners.comment: 0-13 and needs to bounce back having failed to beat a rival at Newcastle last time
runners.name: Jamaican Storm
runners.spotlight: 13-race maiden but he was third at Newcastle (7f, AW) in December and again over this C&D last month; however, he failed to beat a rival home 29 days ago and now has a bit to prove.

runners.comment: Three-time C&D winner; third here on his last two starts and ought to go well again
runners.name: Chola Empire
runners.spotlight: Three-time C&D winner who has been third here on his last two outings; now back on his last winning mark and ought to give his running.

runners.comment: All three of his wins have been over this C&D; below his best behind Chola Empire latest
runners.name: Federal Envoy
runners.owner: Lets Be Lucky Racing 37 & David Carroll
runners.spotlight: Often front-runner who has gained all three over his wins over this C&D, most recently last February off 6lb higher mark than today's; below best in recent starts, including when behind Chola Empire here last month.

runners.comment: Mostly in good form since winning on her stable debut in December; had an excuse last time
runners.name: Bella Bisbee
runners.spotlight: Prominent-racer who made a winning stable debut at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) in December; mostly in good form since but she was below her best at Newcastle two weeks ago, albeit she raced away from the main action with one other.

runners.comment: Two wins when trained by Karl Burke; well beaten on her final start for previous yard
runners.name: Alpine Oasis
runners.spotlight: Two wins when trained by Karl Burke (1m/1m4f); posted her best effort for Darryll Holland when fourth of seven (beaten 1l) here over 1m3f last month but she was well beaten at Kempton (1m3f, AW) in first-time cheekpieces (retained) 16 days ago; drops down markedly in trip for her stable debut.

runners.comment: Low-key return from a break but stepped forward when winning over C&D latest; up in class
runners.name: My Mate Mike
runners.spotlight: Beat only one rival home at Chelmsford (1m, AW) on his first start since returning to this yard following a 161-day break, but he stepped forward from that when winning over this C&D 15 days ago; up in grade following a 3lb rise.

runners.comment: Won at Wolverhampton in December and ran well there last time; wide draw to contend with
runners.name: The Caribbean
runners.spotlight: Notched his first win for this trainer at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) in December and again ran well there when third having been drawn wide 39 days ago; another wide draw to contend with here but he holds solid claims.

runners.comment: Won a seller at Leicester in October; third at Newcastle latest and has each-way claims
runners.name: Packetofbiscuits
runners.owner: A Pot To Pete In Syndicate
runners.spotlight: Won a seller at Leicester (7f, good) in October on his final start for Adrian Nicholls and he was placing for the first time since joining this stable when third of nine at Newcastle (1m, AW) ten days ago; returns to 7f with each-way claims.

runners.comment: Third at Wolverhampton (6f) last month but isn't certain to appreciate the return to 7f
runners.name: Phoenix Of Dreams
runners.spotlight: Generally disappointing since last season's reappearance but was third of ten at Wolverhampton (6f, AW ) last month and ran respectably ten days ago; isn't guaranteed to appreciate the return to this trip.

runners.comment: Scored over C&D last month and ran well here 15 days ago; now steps back up in grade
runners.name: No Knee Never
runners.spotlight: Notched his second win for this yard when scoring over C&D last month before a lesser effort over 1m at Lingfield; bounced back when runner-up here 15 days ago, rallying late, but now steps back up in grade.

runners.comment: Overcame traffic issues at Newcastle (1m) and followed up here last time; drops to 7f
runners.name: Dream Illusion
runners.spotlight: Overcame traffic issues to get up close home at Newcastle (1m, AW) last month and followed up with a comfortable success here over 1m nine days ago; carries a 5lb penalty and this drop back to 7f may not be ideal.

runners.breeder: Mrs Susan Roy & Mr Nicolas Wrigley
runners.comment: Third over C&D in two starts since the tongue-tie was fitted; cheekpieces now added
runners.name: Asian Journey
runners.spotlight: 0-9 but he got back on track in a first-time tongue-tie when third of 12 behind No Knee Never over C&D last month, and filled that same position here 15 days ago (hung left); cheekpieces are now added.

runners.comment: Ran well on her first two starts for this yard but disappointing when last seen
runners.name: Pearly Squirrel
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 16 starts came in first-time cheekpieces at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last July when trained by Ivan Furtado; ran well over 7f at Wolverhampton on her first two starts for this stable but disappointing there over 8.6f when last seen; cheekpieces return.

runners.comment: Regressive and never involved here three weeks ago when behind Pleasant Man
runners.name: Traila
runners.owner: Katy Jane Reed And Edward J Ware
runners.spotlight: Rated a good bit higher in the past but has lost his way and was never involved here three weeks ago when behind Pleasant Man.

runners.comment: Nearly added a third success over this far at Lingfield and gets in off the same mark
runners.name: Wonder
runners.spotlight: His wins have been over 9.4f at Wolverhampton and 2m here; nearly added a third success over this far at Lingfield and gets in off the same mark here with Oisin Murphy taking over; respected with cheekpieces added.

runners.comment: Multiple AW winner; last two efforts weren't his best and unproven over this far
runners.name: Urban Road

runners.comment: 4-13 on the Flat; it wasn't his first below-par effort at Lingfield 20 days ago
runners.name: Knight Templar
runners.spotlight: 4-13 on the Flat; narrow winner over 2m at Kempton and it wasn't his first below-par effort at Lingfield 20 days ago; handles this surface and better can be expected.

runners.comment: Doesn't look as good as he was and cheekpieces are now added
runners.name: Bystander
runners.spotlight: 3-5 on the AW for Karl Burke; nearly won a 9.4f seller at Wolverhampton on debut for this yard after an absence but beaten double-figure lengths in two subsequent handicaps; doesn't look as good as he was and cheekpieces are now added.

runners.comment: Approaching his best when giving an improver something to think about at Kempton
runners.name: Something
runners.spotlight: Has won twice over 1m4f at Newcastle when positively ridden; back to approaching his best when giving an improver something to think about at Kempton (1m3f); enters the reckoning.

runners.breeder: Kenneth L Ramsey & Sarah K Ramsey
runners.comment: Signed off for Mickey Bowen with some ropey efforts over hurdles/fences
runners.name: Isle Of Sark
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose 8yo who has had plenty of racing and an overall strike-rate of 3-48; signed off for Mickey Bowen with some ropey efforts over hurdles/fences and others appeal more on this return to the Flat.

runners.comment: 6lb higher than for his C&D win last August and others might be better treated
runners.name: Motazzen
runners.spotlight: Not in bad form this jumps season but he's 6lb higher than for his C&D win last August and others might be better treated.

runners.comment: Close fourth over 1m6f here recently in a race he won the previous year; good mark
runners.name: Pleasant Man
runners.spotlight: Close fourth over 1m6f here recently in a race he won the previous year off an 8lb higher mark than today's figure; back into a Class 5 now, he should run well.

runners.comment: Formerly useful but well beaten on the Flat and over hurdles for current yard
runners.name: Promethean
runners.spotlight: Useful Flat form for previous connections but well beaten on the Flat and over hurdles for current yard.

runners.comment: Not that competitive in two runs for current yard and all headgear is now removed
runners.name: Loving Look
runners.spotlight: Won on AW and turf for Hughie Morrison at up to this trip; not that competitive in two runs for current yard and all headgear is now removed; bit risky.

runners.comment: Only eighth in his last two races (1m6f/hurdle) and others have less to prove
runners.name: Gifted Angel
runners.spotlight: Has won on the AW and over hurdles, with five victories combined; however, has managed only eighth in his last two races (1m6f/hurdle) and others have less to prove.

runners.comment: Won at Wolverhampton in September but below his best on his next two outings; best watched
runners.name: One More Dream
runners.spotlight: Two-time course winner (6f/7f) who landed a Class 6 handicap at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in September; below his best on his next two outings and is best watched on his return from a 128-day break.

runners.comment: Close third on the AW at Newcastle in November but below his best at Chelmsford latest
runners.name: Bill Plumb
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 6f at Yarmouth last year and was a close third at Newcastle (6f, AW; first-time cheekpieces) in November; held in sixth at Chelmsford (6f, AW) on his return from a break last time, and better is needed.

runners.comment: 0-14 but his most recent effort suggested that returning to this trip would suit
runners.name: Farandaway
runners.spotlight: 0-14 but he's posted two respectable efforts over 5f at Newcastle since returning from a 102-day break, and his most recent one suggested that returning to this trip would suit; each-way chance.

runners.comment: Well suited by the strong pace when winning at Wolverhampton; up in grade off 6lb higher
runners.name: Cargin Bhui
runners.spotlight: Well suited by a strong early pace when finishing well to double his tally at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) two weeks ago; now steps back up in grade but remains well treated on previous form following a 6lb rise.

runners.comment: Won over this C&D in November; never involved after a slow start latest; visor now returns
runners.name: Mumayaz
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark for this yard when winning in a first-time visor over this C&D in November; never featured following a slow start at Kempton (7f, AW) 16 days ago, but he now drops back down in grade and the visor returns.

runners.comment: Looked slightly unfortunate not to win over C&D in December; another solid effort latest
runners.name: Dc Cogent
runners.owner: J R Dwyer And B Smart
runners.spotlight: Sole win came in a Newcastle maiden last March, but he looked slightly unfortunate not to win over this C&D in December (winner has won twice since) before a solid effort at Newcastle (6f, AW) ten days ago; capable.

runners.comment: Won here and at Wolverhampton in a lower grade in December; fair effort last time
runners.name: Zoulu Warrior
runners.spotlight: Doubled his tally when landing a C&D handicap in December and followed up at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) on his next start; respectable effort when stepped up to this grade there 32 days ago, but first-time the blinkers (replacing cheekpieces) need to bring out a bit more.

runners.comment: Below his best since finishing third at Newcastle in December; switch of headgear
runners.name: Brave Empire
runners.owner: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd
runners.spotlight: Front-running third at Newcastle (6f, AW) in December but he's been below that level in two starts since, including in a first-time visor at Newcastle (5f) 16 days ago; switch of headgear.

runners.comment: Beaten a neck at Lingfield last month but below his best six days ago; cheekpieces added
runners.name: Mart
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner but his most recent success came on turf at Lingfield last May; beaten a neck there on the AW last month but he ran below that level six days ago; cheekpieces are now applied.

runners.comment: Both wins on turf but beaten only a neck over 5f at Newcastle 20 days ago; back up in trip
runners.name: I Need Your Love
runners.spotlight: Both of his wins have been on turf, with the most recent coming at Bath (5.7f, heavy) in October; went from the front when beaten a neck at Newcastle (5f, AW) 20 days ago and won't have an issue with the return to this trip.

runners.comment: Four-time AW winner over 5f; below his best since winning at Wolverhampton in December
runners.name: Blue Force
runners.owner: John And Tony Jarvis And Partner
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner over 5f, most recently at Wolverhampton in December; below his best in three starts since and now steps back up to 6f.

runners.comment: Fourth here last month but he failed to beat a rival home at Newcastle last time
runners.name: Blackjack
runners.spotlight: Often front-runner who has won three times over C&D; fourth of nine here last month but he failed to beat a rival home at Newcastle (6f) ten days ago; visor replaces the blinkers worn last time.

runners.comment: Ended long losing run at Newcastle last month; respected under a penalty for Monday's win

runners.spotlight: Ended a lengthy losing run when scoring a Newcastle (6f, AW) last month before finishing fourth at Lingfield; back to winning ways at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) four days ago and commands respect under a 4lb penalty for that success.

runners.comment: Won over C&D on his stable debut in November; two respectable efforts since; has claims
runners.name: Betsen
runners.spotlight: Sprung a 40-1 surprise over C&D on his stable debut in November before finishing fourth of seven behind Silky Wilkie at Newcastle (6f, AW; slowly away); respectable effort at Wolverhampton 17 days ago and holds obvious claims back here.

runners.comment: Made it 2-2 on the AW when winning at Newcastle over 5f; remains well treated after a rise

runners.spotlight: Made it 2-2 on the AW when landing a Newcastle handicap over 5f 29 days ago; that was his first outing for 104 days and he remains well treated following a 4lb rise, although this step back up to 6f isn't guaranteed to suit.

runners.breeder: D & S L Tanker Transport Ltd
runners.comment: Won at Lingfield in December; back to form when beaten a head at Kempton last time
runners.name: Intervention
runners.spotlight: Successful at Lingfield (6f, AW) in December but he was below his best on his next three outings; bounced back to form when beaten a head in a higher grade than this at Kempton (6f, AW) nine days ago and can't be dismissed.

runners.comment: Most recent success came over this C&D off today's mark; third on his last three outings
runners.name: Aberama Gold
runners.spotlight: Isn't the force of old but his most recent success came over this C&D in August off today's mark; third on his last three outings, including behind Silky Wilkie at Newcastle last month, and holds good claims once again.

runners.comment: Has been running well since winning here over 5f last month; step back up to 6f worth a go
runners.name: Star Chorus
runners.spotlight: Narrowly came out on top when winning here over 5f last month before finishing a close third at Lingfield (5f, AW) next time, and shaped as if still in form in a race not run to suit back there ten days ago; step back up to 6f looks worth a try; hood back on.

runners.comment: Struggled in three starts since winning a Racing League handicap in August; best watched
runners.name: Roberto Caro
runners.spotlight: Back to close to his best when winning a Racing League handicap at Chepstow (6f, good) in August but he's struggled in three starts since, including on the AW at Wolverhampton when last seen 88 days ago; best watched on his return.

runners.comment: Had blinkers on when winning at Nottingham in October before finishing midfield at York
runners.name: Jenever
runners.spotlight: Benefited from first-time blinkers when landing a handicap at Nottingham (6f, good to soft) in October before finishing midfield at York (5f, good) on his next start; cheekpieces now replace blinkers on his first start for 133 days.

runners.comment: Three-time AW winner for Jack Channon; posted a fine effort at Wolverhampton on yard debut
runners.name: Cajetan
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner on the AW over 6f when trained by Jack Channon (all in cheekpieces) and he posted a fine effort when third of seven at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) on his stable debut 17 days ago; that was his first start since June and he's an interesting contender.

runners.comment: C&D winner who was better than his finishing position suggests last time; may bounce back
runners.name: Stanley Spencer
runners.spotlight: Two-time C&D winner who was beaten a neck here in November off today's mark; shaped better than his finishing position suggests having been hampered when beating only one rival home at Chelmsford (6f, AW) 22 days ago; capable of bouncing back.

runners.comment: All four wins have been at Newcastle; up 3lb for his 5f win there 16 days ago
runners.name: Monks Dream
runners.spotlight: Has gained all four of his wins at Newcastle, with the most recent of those successes coming there over 5f 16 days ago; 3lb rise looks fair but he was well beaten when last seen over 6f.

runners.comment: Both wins on soft/heavy ground; gelded since last seen 115 days ago; makes his AW debut
runners.name: Station X
runners.spotlight: Both of his wins came in 2024 on soft/heavy ground; fourth of 11 at Ayr (6f, heavy) in October before finishing runner-up on soft ground on his next two outings; returns from 115 days off and now makes his AW debut having been gelded since last seen.

19:00.race_name: SBK: Dont Settle For Less Handicap

runners.comment: Up 3lb for recent Newcastle win and he's pretty consistent on most of the AW tracks
runners.name: Dingle
runners.spotlight: Had the run of things when making all at Newcastle a month ago (1m) but only went up 3lb and he's pretty consistent on most of the AW tracks; solid chance.

runners.comment: Competitively treated should the first-time headgear trigger a return to form
runners.name: Angel Hunter
runners.spotlight: Dual turf winner who won his first race on the AW over 7f here in October but has since finished well behind in two Kempton handicaps (over 1m that he stays); competitively treated should the first-time headgear trigger a return to form.

runners.comment: If forgiven final run, and it was three months ago, then he's not without hope
runners.name: First Ambition
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-2 in a C&D novice in August and wasn't disgraced in two Class 2 handicaps before producing his worst performance yet last time at Newcastle; if forgiven that, and it was three months ago, then he's not without hope.

runners.comment: Good strike-rate; looks handicapped about right now but unlikely to be far away
runners.name: Unassuming
runners.spotlight: Strike-rate of 5-20 and has continued to perform respectably in defeat, from 7f to 1m2f (cheekpieces added the last twice); looks handicapped about right now but unlikely to be far away.

runners.comment: Quickened up best off slow fractions to win over 1m2f at Newcastle 20 days ago
runners.name: Zryan
runners.spotlight: Fairly consistent since arriving from France and quickened up best off slow fractions to win over 1m2f at Newcastle 20 days ago; effective at this shorter trip and has only gone up 3lb.

runners.comment: Made it nine wins at Newcastle last time but he has only raced the twice here
runners.name: Midnight Lion
runners.spotlight: Enhanced his outstanding Newcastle record (all nine AW wins there) on New Year's Day when fending off five rivals; only 2lb higher and he'll probably be ridden positively as usual; has only raced twice here (unplaced).

runners.comment: Last two runs not his best but fairly treated if Oisin Murphy can get him firing
runners.name: Eldrickjones
runners.spotlight: All five AW wins have all come at Newcastle where he was below his best two runs back and again here three weeks ago; fairly treated if he could produce something better under Oisin Murphy and has form here.

runners.comment: Ideally positioned last time in Zryan's race but still couldn't get the job done
runners.name: Londoner
runners.spotlight: Poor strike-rate of 2-35 but often thereabouts, as the last twice over 1m3f and 1m2f; was ideally positioned last time in Zryan's race but still couldn't get the job done; dropping back to 1m shouldn't hurt his chances, though.

runners.comment: Ran in a Class 2 last time but that was his third below-par performance in succession
runners.name: Crack On Boys
runners.spotlight: A well-treated dual Tapeta winner at Newcastle who ran in a Class 2 there last time but that was his third below-par performance in succession; has to bounce back.

runners.comment: 7f too sharp last time; all handicap wins at Class 4 level and this is a Class 3
runners.name: Invited
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who prevailed narrowly over 1m at Lingfield (fourth career win) on New Year's Eve; 7f perhaps too sharp here last time but that was still disappointing given he was beaten 8l; all handicap wins at Class 4 level and this is a Class 3.

runners.comment: Unlucky not to have opened his handicap account last time at Newcastle; good chance
runners.name: Dosman
runners.spotlight: Only 1-13 and the win was in 2024; however, would probably have opened his account in handicaps but for some late interference at Newcastle two weeks ago (1m); every chance off 1lb  higher.

runners.comment: Goes well at Newcastle where he shaped nicely after a break in a Class 2 last month
runners.name: Rogue Encore
runners.spotlight: Unraced here but goes particularly well at Newcastle (all three wins there at 1m) where he shaped nicely after a break in a Class 2 last month; this mark isn't beyond him.

runners.comment: First and second in two Flat runs for Noel Meade; not to be passed over lightly
runners.name: Gambino
runners.spotlight: Made a promising start for Noel Meade, winning a 9.5f maiden before finishing second in 1m4f handicap (both on turf); joined Dan Skelton to go hurdling (withdrawn ahead of intended debut last month) but with his Flat experience and low mileage, he can't be dismissed.

runners.comment: Debut form worked out well and he then won easily on Dundalk AW; Group-race potential
runners.name: Square Necker

runners.comment: Top-class hurdler making Flat debut after suffering three falls in his last four races
runners.name: Constitution Hill
runners.spotlight: Last jumps campaign started well but ended badly, as he took back-to-back falls at Cheltenham/Aintree and then laboured when he did complete at Punchestown; suffered another tumble on his reappearance in the Fighting Fifth in November, which has prompted this switch to the Flat in the hope of restoring confidence levels ahead of a possible bid to regain the Champion Hurdle crown he won in 2023.

runners.comment: Not as good a hurdler as Constitution Hill but he's smart; should have a part to play
runners.name: Daddy Long Legs
runners.spotlight: Not as good a hurdler as Constitution Hill but he's smart, finishing a flattering second to State Man in last year's Irish Champion Hurdle and then competitive in two strong handicaps; last seen beaten at odds-on in a 1m5f maiden at Ballinrobe but that's turned out to be a strong race and he reportedly finished lame; ability much respected on this AW debut.

runners.comment: Useful bumper form but he's up against a different calibre of opposition here
runners.name: Grazeon Sunshine
runners.spotlight: It's been a bright start in bumpers, winning second time out at Sedgefield and second to a good horse at Aintree on Boxing Day; however, up against a very different calibre of opposition here and would be a surprise winner.

runners.comment: There are a few in here who would comfortably have his measure over hurdles
runners.name: Mr McLoughlan
runners.spotlight: This jumps season is going well, with three wins (at about 2m) already but he was down the field in a Musselburgh handicap on latest start and there are a few in here who would comfortably have his measure over hurdles.

runners.comment: 3-8 over hurdles in Britain but below his best on last two outings; not the obvious answer
runners.name: Nardaran
runners.spotlight: Placed in his sole Flat start when trained in France (1m4f); 3-8 over hurdles in Britain but has failed to show his true form on last two outings and this is no easy race in which to bounce back, returned to the Flat.

runners.comment: Point winner who is 3-5 over hurdles (Grade 2 honours); makes Flat debut after an absence
runners.name: Roadlesstravelled
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced hurdler with Grade 2-winning honours in late 2024; signed off that campaign with two non-completions and this winning pointer makes Flat debut after nearly a year off; looks very vulnerable.

runners.comment: Lightly raced winning hurdler but not in the same league as some of these in that scene
runners.name: Star Artist
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced winning hurdler but not in the same league as some of these in that scene; Flat/AW debut.

runners.comment: Very capable hurdler who ran well last time; won an AW bumper earlier in career
runners.name: Tripoli Flyer
runners.spotlight: Never took to fences during opening half of the jumps season but it was a notable effort to finish second under a big weight in an Ascot handicap hurdle a month ago (2m3f) and he has winning form on the AW, having won a Lingfield bumper just over two years ago; the widest draw isn't ideal but he has each-way hopes.

runners.comment: Bred to win races on the Flat but likely best watched in a race of this nature
runners.name: Noble Way
runners.spotlight: 12,000euros 2yo; second foal out of a French maiden (best run at 10.5f; RPR 69) and half-sister to French 6.5f 2yo winner Al Motasim; bred to win races on the Flat but likely best watched in a race of this nature.

runners.comment: Only last week she was a remote last of four in a 1m2f novice on the AW
runners.name: Masked Mistress
runners.spotlight: The winner of two bumpers but beaten on both starts over hurdles (tailed off latest) and only last week she was a remote last of four in a 1m2f novice on the AW.

runners.comment: Three defeats hurdling, including in a claimer, and she'd be aptly named if winning this
runners.name: Miracles Do Happen
runners.spotlight: Three defeats over hurdles, including in a claimer, and she'd be aptly named if winning this.

runners.comment: Placed in a bumper but now exposed as a limited hurdler and this is her third trainer
runners.name: Tres Bien
runners.spotlight: Placed in a bumper but now exposed as a limited hurdler and this is her third trainer after seven starts.

runners.comment: Signs of a full revival in recent starts; not ruled out
runners.name: Master Of My Fate
runners.owner: Ms Janelle Cao Ross Harmon & Partner
runners.spotlight: Enjoyed a good winter last year and there have been more encouraging signs in recent starts, including a C&D second last month; capable of another prominent showing.

runners.comment: Rarely runs a bad race on AW and should go well despite his mark creeping back up
runners.name: Almaty Star
runners.spotlight: Rarely runs a bad race on AW and he hasn't been beaten far in any of his four starts this winter; edging back up the weights but unlikely to be too far away.

runners.comment: Shot 30lb up the weights for his yard since last July; in deeper today & may come up short
runners.name: Sams Hope
runners.owner: D Morgan And K J Parris
runners.spotlight: Transformed by her new yard since July, winning five times and climbing 30lb up the weights (last three wins have been over C&D); had an excuse at Wolverhampton three weeks ago but hard to believe there aren't better treated sprinters in this field.

runners.comment: Ended long losing run over C&D last month; still feasibly weighted and e-w claims at least
runners.name: Existent
runners.spotlight: Couldn't begrudge him his C&D win last month having run numerous good races in defeat during a near four-year barren spell; not an obvious one to follow up but no doubting he has the ability to feature.

runners.comment: On winning mark and conditions won't be an issue; he'll ned to be on top form after break
runners.name: Blind Beggar
runners.owner: New Vision Bloodstock & Steel A Win
runners.spotlight: Rated higher in his pomp and last summer's Sandown win for Mick Appleby came off this mark; he'll need to be on top form to take this after a 112-day absence though.

runners.comment: Irish raider; sharper for recent run; last July's Curragh win worked out well; interesting
runners.name: Cuban Grey
runners.spotlight: Strong form when winning a big-field handicap at the Curragh last summer off 4lb lower; fair form in three of his four runs since, the latest a Dundalk handicap (5f AW) two weeks ago; that was his first run for 170 days and he could well take a step forward; interesting.

runners.comment: Lightly raced for a 5yo; retained ability last year; back from a break in competitive race
runners.name: Sports Coach
runners.spotlight: Lightly-raced 5yo who showed flashes of retaining a good deal of ability in his five runs in 2025; he will need to up his game to win this after 195 days off though.

runners.comment: Three wins last year; mark still in range and recent return was promising; shortlisted
runners.name: Nogos Dream
runners.spotlight: Discovered the winning habit last summer, scoring at Chelmsford and twice at Windsor (all 5f); now 1lb lower than for the latest win and his recent return to action at Lingfield was promising; high on the list.

runners.comment: Had excuses on Monday and in good form beforehand; high enough in the weights now
runners.name: El Bufalo
runners.spotlight: All wins around a bend but he has run well on the straight track at Newcastle; had been in good form prior to a lesser run at Wolverhampton on Monday but plenty went wrong for him there; better than that but still perhaps vulnerable in this field.

runners.breeder: His Highness The Aga Khans Studs S C
runners.comment: C&D win last year came in Class 5; has the ability to feature but 4-month absence to defy
runners.name: Zarzyni
runners.spotlight: Hasn't won as often as one of his ability probably should but he did score twice in 2025, the latter win over C&D; 3lb higher in a better race this time and he'll need to be somewhere near last year's best to take this after four months off.

runners.comment: 1-9 in Hong Kong; makes British debut after 429 days off; promise on dirt; tough to assess
runners.name: Golden Long
runners.spotlight: The winner of one of his nine starts in Hong Kong (all over 6f); the win was on turf but promise on dirt; not easy to assess on stable debut after 429 days off.

runners.breeder: Executors Of The Late Mr J L C Pearce
runners.comment: On long losing run but arrives in form and should go well granted luck in running
runners.name: Juan Les Pins
runners.spotlight: Losing run stretches back to June 2023 but he is operating off a reduced mark now and he has finished third in two runs this year (both 5f, Newcastle and here); needs a strong pace and plenty of luck but the ability is there if things pan out favourably.

20:30.race_name: SBK: No Casino Just Sports Handicap

runners.comment: Arrives in fine form and back down in class after latest Class 3 third; in the mix again
runners.name: Down To The Kid
runners.spotlight: Couldn't complete his hat-trick here three weeks ago but he still ran well for third in a Class 3; nudged up another 2lb but he's in the form of his life and shouldn't be too far away.

runners.comment: Returned from a break to win three AW handicaps on the bounce; should go well again
runners.name: Eligible
runners.spotlight: No signs of age dimming his enthusiasm, returning from five months off to win a C&D handicap in December and adding wins at Newcastle (1m) and back over C&D since; another 3lb higher today but can't rule out in current form.

runners.comment: Had few chances at 7f & his Ascot 2nd in October was a fine effort; low-key stable debut
runners.name: I Still Have Faith
runners.owner: J Morley D Reynolds C Watkins & Partner
runners.spotlight: Not on a bad mark on the pick of his form for Ben Brookhouse and although most of his racing has been done over further, he ran a cracker at Ascot last October; low-key stable debut this month but capable of better; stable also run North View.

runners.comment: Ended 2025 with two good runs at Kempton; not so good latest and more to prove on Tapeta
runners.name: Metaverse
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with two good placed efforts at Kempton; not at the same level at Lingfield last month and he has a bit more to prove on Tapteta.

runners.comment: Ran okay upped to 7f last month but he will need more to come out on top here
runners.name: Secret Guest
runners.spotlight: No match for the improving winner but finished a creditable second over C&D last month, his first attempt at 7f; runs off the same mark and needs to up his game a notch.

runners.comment: New yard quick to drop her back in trip and Oisin Murphy booked; not discounted
runners.name: Madame De Sevigne
runners.spotlight: Two turf wins (7f) for Robert Eddery in 2024; 0-9 last year but retained ability; new yard (same owners) quick to drop her back in trip and Oisin Murphy booked; not discounted.

runners.comment: Becoming more realistically treated again now but needs to raise his game to take this
runners.name: Bravo Zulu
runners.spotlight: Started this AW campaign high in the weights after an excellent time of things last winter; latest Lingfield ninth (beaten 2.5l) was his best run this time around; cheekpieces back on today (tried in an eyeshield latest).

runners.comment: Disappointing in 2025 but back to form for new yard last month and there's more to come
runners.name: North View
runners.spotlight: His Newbury win in August 2024 (7f, good to firm) was a fine effort and suggested he could thrive as a 4yo but 2025 was a shade disappointing, albeit he did much of his racing over 1m+; new stable quick to drop him back to 7f and he won decisively at Chelmsford last month, form that looks solid enough; could well have more to come and he's a strong contender.

runners.breeder: S A S Ecurie De Cachene & Earl Haras D
runners.comment: Has looked good on occasions and edging down the weights; headgear absent today
runners.name: Tennessee Gold
runners.spotlight: Has looked good on occasions and no problem with today's conditions; ran okay here four weeks ago given his saddle slipped; cheeekpieces worn last time are now left off.

runners.comment: Had a good 2025 and three solid efforts so far this year; more needed to defy this mark
runners.name: Commander Of Life
runners.spotlight: Won three times last year and he has returned from three months off with three solid AW efforts; work to do with a couple of reopposing rivals but should give his running.

runners.breeder: Ringfort Stud Ltd & M&p Bloodstock Ltd
runners.comment: 7f win last month before lesser run latest; sold 20,000gns since; widest stall to overcome
runners.name: Echalar
runners.spotlight: Gelded prior to a hard-fought win at Wolverhampton last month (7f); failed to back it up 16 days ago and has been sold out of Jane Chapple-Hyam's stable for 20,000gns since; drawn widest and others are more appealing.

runners.breeder: Attiyah I E I Castillon Prairies
runners.comment: Should make his mark in handicaps at some point but returns from an absence in a warm race
runners.name: Deauville Blue
runners.spotlight: Some promise in two runs for Charles Hills as a 2yo and again on his stable debut last May; should make his mark in handicaps at some point but he returns from an absence in a competitive race.

14:14.race_name: Best Odds Guaranteed Overnight At CopyBet Novices' Hurdle (Novices' Championship Hurdle Qual') (GBB)

runners.breeder: S C E A Le Haras DHaspel
runners.comment: Bled latest, but progressive beforehand and would have obvious claims if back to best.
runners.name: Doctor Blue
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who went close in Cheltenham Grade 2 on hurdle debut before getting off the mark at Ascot (1m7f, good; first-time tongue-tie) in November; found to have bled when well held at Doncaster since, which is a concern, but would have obvious claims if back to best with cheekpieces added.

runners.comment: Taken well to hurdles and should be competitive again if coping with more testing ground.
runners.name: Kapitein Kool
runners.spotlight: Made a winning hurdling debut at Newton Abbot (2m1f, good to soft) in October and has bettered that form twice since under a penalty, most recently when a 3l second at Taunton (2m3f, good) last month; should be competitive again back in trip if coping with more testing ground.

runners.comment: Progressive 5yo who merits consideration now back in trip returned to novice company.
runners.name: Lisbane Park
runners.spotlight: Won well over C&D in November and, although well held, wasn't disgraced under a penalty when fourth in a strong Cheltenham (2m1f; good to soft) novice next time; shaped well again when third on last month's handicap debut at Windsor (2m4f, soft) and merits consideration now back in trip and returned to novice company.

runners.comment: 1m2f Flat winner who has made no impact over hurdles so far; easy to look elsewhere.
runners.name: Forest Hills
runners.spotlight: 1m2f Flat winner who has been beaten 77l and 71l in two runs over hurdles; may find life easier when qualified for a mark and it's easy to look elsewhere.

runners.comment: Has shown some ability in three bumpers but needs a marked step forward on hurdle debut.
runners.name: Maximum Benefit
runners.spotlight: Has shown ability in three bumpers but will need a marked step forward now sent hurdling if he's to make an impact; likely to be of more interest further down the line.

runners.comment: Tailed off in a bumper and again well held on hurdle debut.
runners.name: Dalcassian Girl
runners.spotlight: Narrowly beaten in a small-field Irish point (3m, heavy) a year ago but has offered little in two runs under rules, tailed off in a bumper and well beaten again when sent over hurdles; plenty to prove.

runners.comment: Well held on hurdle debut eight days ago and looks one for the longer term.
runners.name: Follow The Plan
runners.spotlight: Placed in an Irish point but that form doesn't look strong and she showed little on hurdle debut at Taunton (2m, heavy) eight days ago; likely one for the longer term.

runners.comment: Looked set for an improved run when unseating latest, but that was over further.
runners.name: Miss Jaffa Cake
runners.spotlight: Tailed off on first two hurdle runs but looked set for an improved effort when unseating three out at Wincanton last month over a longer trip; comes back in distance and may be one for handicaps in due course.

14:44.race_name: Bev, Margaret & Iris Bond Memorial Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Out-and-out stayer who could resume progress after pulling up (bad mistake) last time
runners.name: Itseemslikeit
runners.spotlight: Took his form to a new level after being switched to fences following wind surgery, winning his first two races (3m, heavy) before pulling up at Newbury two weeks ago after a bad mistake five out; out-and-out stayer who could resume progress with conditions ideal.

runners.breeder: R F And S D Knipe
runners.comment: Below par at Ascot last time but still early days and hard to dismiss; cheekpieces added.
runners.name: Laganhill
runners.spotlight: Dual soft-ground hurdle winner at around 2m last season; made a promising start over fences at Carlisle and stepped forward from that when a staying-on second, upped to 3m, at Bangor (heavy) next time; below that level at Ascot latest, but still early days in this sphere and he's not one to dismiss with cheekpieces added.

runners.comment: Unexposed 7yo who is an intriguing chase and handicap debutant following a break.
runners.name: Mountain Mike
runners.spotlight: Stepped up on debut promise when readily opening his hurdle account at the second attempt at Ffos Las (2m6f, heavy) just over a year ago; connections waste little time in switching him to fences and this longer trip promises to suit; interesting contender off what looks a fair opening mark if ready to go following a break.

runners.breeder: Joel Denis Clotilde De Barmon Emmanuel
runners.comment: Not yet fully exposed over fences or at the trip and may improve for the new headgear.
runners.name: Kalhandrion
runners.spotlight: Has left hurdle form well behind since switched to fences, winning on chase debut at Huntingdon (2m4f; stays 3m) and solid efforts on both completed starts since; unseated rider when still travelling well in the lead at Doncaster on latest; not yet fully exposed and could play a significant role if handling testing conditions, with cheekpieces now added.

15:14.race_name: Safer Gambling At CopyBet Mares' Chase (Listed Race) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Latest run was a step back in the right direction; the chase form pick even on that result
runners.name: Fun Fun Fun
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who had a Grade 3 novice at Limerick (3m, yielding to soft; has won on heavy) last March among three chase wins last term; below form both starts (hurdle/chase) this season but latest, in which she did not lead, was a step back in the right direction; the chase form pick even on that result.

runners.comment: Fine leap at the last and kept on well to see off sole rival at Doncaster (upped to 3m)
runners.name: Blue Las
runners.spotlight: 2-2 on heavy going; unseated on chase debut in November and her jumping lacked fluency when second of three in Listed mares' novice at Warwick (2m4f) next time; appeared to step up when winning a two-runner beginners' chase at Doncaster (upped to 3m, good) latest, finding a fine leap at the last and keeping on well to make all; should have more to offer.

runners.comment: After one attempt, she has some way to go before she's matching today's rivals over fences
runners.name: Della Casa Lunga
runners.spotlight: Three front-running hurdle wins in 2024 (2m5f/3m, soft/good to soft) and she was running pretty well in defeat towards the end of 2025; 10l second of four at Carlisle 17 days ago on chase debut, showing she has some way to go before she's matching today's rivals over fences.

15:45.race_name: Nick Ansell, Devon National Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Some encouragement for this second crack at a marathon trip; blinkers replace cheekpieces
runners.name: Largy Poet
runners.spotlight: Won the novice handicap (3m, heavy) on this card last year on chase debut; October reappearance was better than his three subsequent efforts but there was some renewed encouragement under Freddie Keighley at Wincanton (3m1f, heavy; 11l second of six) last time, including for this second crack at a marathon trip; blinkers replace usual cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Won this last year and also over C&D in December, both in the mud off 6lb lower than today
runners.name: Art Decco
runners.spotlight: Won by 9l over C&D (soft) in December, matching his gutsy win in this race last year (heavy) as a career best; one problem is that both of those were off 6lb lower than today; another is that he showed little in the Surrey National last time, but he needs plenty of respect back here.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras De Montaigu
runners.comment: Flop when Welsh National favourite last time but the ground was surely not soft enough
runners.name: Jubilee Express
runners.spotlight: Below form on sole jumps start on heavy; finished strongest when second in the Welsh National at Chepstow (extended 3m6f, soft) in December 2024; won the Trial there in December this season, which is far and away the best of his last four starts but the ground was surely not soft enough for him when he flopped as favourite in the Welsh National last time; major player if this is one of his better days.

runners.comment: Some renewed hope from latest start, when 2m3f was too short; unproven beyond 3m1f
runners.name: Sizable Sam
runners.spotlight: 11yo who has had some layoffs; unseated at the first fence on November reappearance; fifth of ten here eight days later, when 2m3f was probably far too short, was a step back in the right direction and his sole chase win (from ten attempts) was at this track, but he's yet to prove himself beyond 3m1f (tailed off once over 3m2f); acts on soft but not the percentage call.

runners.comment: Rallied strongly for close second in the Surrey National at Lingfield (3m5f, soft) latest
runners.name: Catch Catchfire
runners.spotlight: Fifth in the Borders National at Kelso (4m, soft; unraced on heavy) in December was up with his best at the time; suffered an early mishap next time but raised his game when rallying strongly for a close second in the Surrey National at Lingfield (3m5f, soft; jumped to his right) on latest start, which puts him firmly in the mix despite this 5lb higher mark and going this way round could help; he should have a big shout.

runners.comment: 2-2 on heavy; won latest outing; back up 5lb for this first appearance beyond 3m1f
runners.name: Icaque de LIsle
runners.spotlight: 2-2 on heavy going (one in Britain); first chase win was in France in 2022 and it was his 12th attempt in a British chase when he finally won one at Lingfield (extended 2m7f, soft) last month; back up 5lb for this first appearance beyond 3m1f, so others appear more solid.

runners.breeder: S C E A Elevage De Clermont
runners.comment: Modest latest run for O Murphy; back with Andy Irvine and well handicapped if back on song
runners.name: Gold Clermont
runners.spotlight: 3m5f/3m3f wins on soft at Fakenham in winter 2023-24; flopped in this race last year on final start for this yard and although she ran creditably on first two outings this term for Olly Murphy, latest (Windsor) was disappointing; back with Andy Irvine and well handicapped if straight back on song.

runners.comment: Won latest but now 8lb higher, including 3lb out of handicap; unproven with trip/ground
runners.name: Ithaka
runners.owner: K P Marsh Plastering & Interiors Ltd
runners.spotlight: 4l winner under Freddie Mitchell at Hereford (extended 3m1f) in January on latest outing but 8lb higher today, including 3lb out of the handicap; also not proven on worse than good to soft (had two attempts on soft) and this sort of trip is something new to him.

16:15.race_name: Ludo Sports & Live Lounge Mares' Handicap Hurdle (Challenger Mares' Hurdle Series Final Qualifier)

runners.comment: Yet to win a handicap, but plenty of solid placed efforts and conditions will suit.
runners.name: Game Colours
runners.spotlight: Sole win over hurdles came in a mares' novice at Lingfield (2m, soft) a year ago and she's still seeking her first handicap success, though she has posted some solid placed efforts, latest when a good second at Windsor (2m4f, soft) on New Year's Day; return to heavy ground will pose no problem and she's sure to be involved.

runners.comment: Progressing well this season and didn't run badly in a Cheltenham class 2 latest; player.
runners.name: Sweet Caryline
runners.spotlight: Progressive mare with three wins this season; respectable sixth in stronger company at Cheltenham (2m4f, good to soft) last time, 4.5l behind Game Colours; better off at the weights with that rival and a bold bid for a fourth win of the campaign can be expected if she handles these more testing conditions.

runners.comment: Going the right way and remains with potential, but this opening mark is no gift.
runners.name: Klassy Pearl
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in both Irish points and has shown promise on all three starts over hurdles for current yard, notably on latest when 5.5l second at Ayr (2m, soft) last month; yet to encounter heavy ground and opening mark no gift, but she remains with potential.

runners.comment: Disappointing on latest but she's hard to ignore on handicap debut for her top stable.
runners.name: Coolkatie
runners.spotlight: In the process of improving on her debut fourth in November (2m, good to soft) when falling late at Warwick on New Year's Eve (2m5f, good to soft), but below that level when fourth at Ayr (2m, soft) last month, nearly 7l behind Klassy Pearl; untested on heavy ground, but she's hard to ignore switched to handicaps for her top stable.

runners.breeder: Dr V Bernard Stoffel & Mr J P Guisset
runners.comment: Thriving in points and a key player returned to rules with Harry Cobden booked.
runners.name: Noble Blue
runners.spotlight: Fair maiden over hurdles and fences for Paul Nolan in 2023-24 but he's thrived in points for Joshua Newman since, winning six of his nine starts, three this season; looks to have been found a good opportunity on debut for Kayley Woollacott, reverting to hurdles off a competitive mark and with Harry Cobden booked.

runners.comment: Consistent gelding who should be thereabouts, if coping with the ground now up in trip.
runners.name: Ugo Bingo
runners.spotlight: Consistent gelding who went close on reappearance here in October; has not improved on that since and yet to be tested on ground as testing as this, but still likely to be in the mix if stamina holds up over this longer trip.

runners.comment: Has yet to fire over hurdles but interesting to see what new stable can do with him.
runners.name: Western Harmony
runners.spotlight: 2023 Irish point winner who showed promise in bumpers but has yet to really transfer it to hurdles and was pulled up a year ago on handicap debut (3m, soft; first-time cheekpieces) on final start for Nicky Henderson; interesting to see what the new stable can do with him; market will guide.

runners.comment: Recent efforts haven't been without promise but opening mark is no gift now up in trip.
runners.name: Tobi Kanobee
runners.spotlight: Poor pointer; well held at three-digit odds in his qualifying runs but there has been some promise; longer trip may suit but opening mark is no gift.

runners.comment: Failed to show any immediate benefit for wind surgery latest; makes handicap debut.
runners.name: Jaja Jimmy
runners.spotlight: Best effort when placed in a bumper; yet to show much over hurdles and failed to show any immediate benefit for wind surgery at Kempton (2m5f, good to soft) 18 days ago; best watched now switched to handicaps.

runners.comment: Recent efforts have been underwhelming but he's reunited with Ciaran O'Shea; interesting.
runners.name: Bredon Hill Dart
runners.owner: R W And Mrs Mitchell D V Gardner
runners.spotlight: 1-16 under rules and recent efforts don't inspire much confidence; however, he can cope with testing conditions, so there are grounds for cautious optimism reunited with 7lb claimer Ciaran O'Shea, who was in the saddle for his sole success.

runners.comment: Nudged up 2lb for his recent effort and respected if arriving in the same mood.
runners.name: Watchoutitscookie
runners.spotlight: Infrequent winner but returned to form back over hurdles with a good second at Wincanton (2m4f) three weeks ago, coping well with the heavy ground; nudged up 2lb but has a chance if arriving in the same mood.

runners.comment: Needs the change in headgear to spark a major revival.
runners.name: William Philo
runners.spotlight: Made a bright start to last year with a good second over C&D on New Year's Day, but his form has taken a marked downturn since and recent efforts have been poor; new headgear needs to spark a revival.

17:20.race_name: Greendale Farm Shop Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 2 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Won when 5-6 at Carlisle (2m1f, soft) in November and the runner-up has done well since
runners.name: Loveable Reprobate
runners.spotlight: His trainer's only runner on the card when he won a seven-runner bumper at Carlisle (2m1f, soft) in November, leading over 1f out at 5-6, and the runner-up has done well since; gives 7lb and more all round today but he showed his inexperience on that debut and should improve.

runners.comment: 32,000euros 3yo; sixth foal; half-brother to four winners including high-class Cloth Cap
runners.name: All About Trev
runners.spotlight: 42,000euros foal, 32,000euros 3yo; sixth foal; half-brother to four winners including Cloth Cap (high-class 2m4f-3m2f hurdle/chase), Liosduin Bhearna (useful 2m3f-3m hurdle) and Brideswell Lad (useful 2m4f-3m2f hurdle/chase); dam 2m hurdle winner; trainer had a bumper winner on rules debut in December (having won a point); clearly needs a second look.

runners.comment: The same yard scored on debut for this one's half-sister and useful dam
runners.name: I Can See Formiles
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; brother to bumper/2m3f-3m hurdle winner I Spy A Diva; dam Listed bumper and useful 2m2f-3m hurdle winner, sister to useful 2m2f-2m5f hurdle/chase winner Max Bygraves; last month saw a bumper winner for the yard, the same which scored on debut for this one's half-sister and dam.

runners.comment: Dam bumper (debut) and 2m2f-2m5f hurdle winner; trainer 0-15 in bumpers this season
runners.name: Mighty Mass
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-brother to point winner Ballyhawkish; dam bumper (debut) and fairly useful 2m2f-2m5f hurdle winner, closely related to smart 1m7f-3m2f hurdle/chase winner Annsam, out of 2m4f-3m1f chase winner; trainer 0-15 in bumpers this season but Harry Cobden is a notable booking.

runners.comment: Only 4th as 6-4 favourite at Aintree (good to soft) on Boxing Day but significant ability
runners.name: Moments In Time
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to fairly useful 2m5f/2m7f hurdle winner A Perfect Day; dam unraced half-sister to useful 2m3f/2m6f hunter chase winner; won an Irish maiden point in March; 6-4 favourite for bumper at Aintree (good to soft) on Boxing Day, which he failed to live up to but he showed significant ability in fourth of eight from off the pace and should improve.

runners.comment: 12-1 when fifth of 12 at Chepstow (2m, soft) last month but that was a 26l defeat
runners.name: Thepassingcyclone
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam runner-up in 2m/2m5f hurdle races, out of bumper/1m6f Flat winner; 12-1 when fifth of 12 at Chepstow (2m, soft) last month but that 26l defeat leaves him with a lot to find.

runners.name: Ramaah
